notes: The stages a section can play on. One backdrop per section, for its whole length; with policy `rotate` the next section uses a different one, picked by what the section mostly shows. All are dark and cool or neutral: never a warm or reddish background. Patterns sit on the half-unit lattice (67.5 px at 1080p = 0.5 Manim units) and are anchored on the frame centre, so objects placed on whole and half units line up with them. Both engines paint the same generated PNG (tools/backdrops.py), so a cut between engines never shifts the backdrop by a pixel. Sizes are px at 1080p.

black.name: Black
black.use_for: 3D, dense math, anything where a pattern would compete with fine detail

dots.name: Black Field
dots.mood: black with a measured field: mathematical, spatial
dots.use_for: math, vectors, graphs and plots, concepts and metaphors, reveals and recaps

ink.name: Ink
ink.use_for: narrative beats, prompts and sentences, people and stories

graphite.use_for: code, terminals, tools, step-by-step procedures, comparisons
